name: hcapp_getCompletedDownDowns
description: Returns the DownDown charges a member may see for a run, with each charge's list of named hashers: completed ones (IsDone=1, IsCancelled=0) while the run is upcoming or under way, and every non-cancelled charge — pending included, isDone says which — once the run started more than six hours ago (the app's own past-run rule). Visible to any kennel member (non-removed HasherKennelMap row). Returns two result rowsets on success. Intended for the run detail history view — non-admin users see only what was delivered. Read-only SP — no success envelope. New feature — no HC5 equivalent.

parameters.name: deviceId
parameters.description: Registered device UUID. Passed to HC6.ValidateAppAuth for auth resolution.

parameters.name: accessToken
parameters.description: Short-lived auth token validated against DeviceSecret.

parameters.name: kennelId
parameters.description: Kennel that owns the event. Required — null or zero-UUID triggers validation error. Defaults to NULL when omitted (2026-10-13).

parameters.name: eventId
parameters.description: Event to fetch completed DownDowns for. Required — null or zero-UUID triggers validation error. Defaults to NULL when omitted (2026-10-13).

rowsets.name: ErrorEnvelope
rowsets.description: Compact error envelope on auth failure or missing kennelId/eventId (errorCode 1234, errorType 2, logged at line 84): { success=0, errorCode, errorType }, followed by StandardErrorResult at index 1. Non-membership is NOT an error — it yields empty rowsets. Mutually exclusive with CompletedDownDowns.

rowsets.name: CompletedDownDowns
rowsets.description: On success: one row per charge the caller may see, ordered by CreatedAt ASC — IsDone = 1 and IsCancelled = 0 while the run is upcoming or under way; every IsCancelled = 0 charge (pending included) once EventStartDateTimeGmt is more than six hours ago. Empty when the caller is not a member of @kennelId (HasherKennelMap row with removed = 0) or nothing qualifies. Mutually exclusive with ErrorEnvelope.

columns.name: downDownId
columns.description: HC.DownDowns.id — primary key of the charge.

columns.name: isDone
columns.description: HC.DownDowns.IsDone — BIT column, serialised as a JSON boolean by the .NET shim. Always true while the run is upcoming/under way; on a past run false marks a charge nobody marked done.

columns.name: isCancelled
columns.description: HC.DownDowns.IsCancelled — BIT column; always false in this result set (filter predicate enforces it). Serialised as JSON boolean.

columns.name: songChoice
columns.description: HC.DownDowns.SongChoice — suggested song name, or NULL if not set.

columns.name: songId
columns.description: HC.DownDowns.SongId cast to lowercase NVARCHAR(40) via LOWER(CAST(...)). NULL if not set.

columns.name: chargePhotoUrl
columns.description: HC.DownDowns.ChargePhotoUrl — blob URL of an attached charge photo, or NULL.

columns.name: externalNames
columns.description: HC.DownDowns.ExternalNames — JSON array of names of people charged who are not in the app (e.g. ["Dizzy Lizzy"]), or NULL. Added with hcapp_addDownDown @externalNames; line 128.

columns.name: createdByDisplayName
columns.description: HC.Hasher.DisplayName (persisted computed column) for the charge creator.

columns.name: createdByPhoto
columns.description: HC.Hasher.Photo for the charge creator — profile photo URL.

columns.name: createdAt
columns.description: HC.DownDowns.CreatedAt — UTC datetime when the charge was created.

rowsets.name: CompletedDownDownHashers
rowsets.description: On success: one row per charged registered hasher for the charges in rowset 0 (same predicates). The client groups by downDownId. People named only in externalNames have no row here. Empty when rowset 0 is empty.

columns.name: downDownId
columns.description: HC.DownDownHashers.DownDownId — FK linking back to rowset 0.

columns.name: displayName
columns.description: HC.Hasher.DisplayName (persisted computed column) for the charged hasher.

rowsets.description: Returned at index 1 after the ErrorEnvelope on auth or validation failure. Mutually exclusive with CompletedDownDownHashers.

sideEffects: INSERT HC.ErrorLog on missing parameters (1234, line 84) and, with THROW, on an unhandled error (line 158). Nothing is written on success.

codeSmells.detail: These parameters have no SQL default, so a call that omits one is refused by SQL Server before the procedure runs (unlogged empty 500): @deviceId, @accessToken. On 2026-10-13 every parameter whose body already handled NULL (and every sync watermark) was given a default; these remain because they are the auth pair or the body never checks them for NULL.

codeSmells.issue: IsDone and IsCancelled columns are BIT, not SMALLINT
codeSmells.detail: HC.DownDowns.IsDone and IsCancelled are BIT NOT NULL. The .NET shim serialises BIT as JSON boolean. Dart callers must parse these as boolean, not int. Both will always be constant values in this result set (isDone=true, isCancelled=false), but the Dart model still needs correct deserialization.

codeSmells.issue: spNumber 58 is shared with hcapp_getCompletedDownDowns and hcapp_updateDownDown
codeSmells.detail: hcapp_updateDownDown (line 72) and hcapp_getCompletedDownDowns (line 59) both pass @spNumber = 58 to ValidateAppAuth, so their auth-failure errorCodes collide (1158 / 1258 / 1358). spNumber feeds only the error code, so the effect is an ambiguous HC.ErrorLog code, not a security issue.
Line 42 sets NOCOUNT only. Harmless for a read, inconsistent with the HC6 standard.
